controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T18:35:57.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T19:35:57.000Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
        AND (message LIKE "*authorized_keys*" OR message LIKE "*.ssh*")
| STATS events     = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY dataset = data_stream.dataset
| SORT events DESC
